# Session: items

`cinnabar:session/items@0.1.0`

The session's items as the vanilla creative screen and recipe book know them: the server's
creative content in its order, then every other item the item registry names, by network id.
Every function errs only when the `items` permission is denied.

**Grants:** `items`.

## Types

<a id="type-item-key"></a>

### `item-key`

An item by identifier and aux value (metadata).

```wit
record item-key {
    identifier: string,
    aux: u16,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identifier` | `string` |  |
| `aux` | `u16` |  |

<a id="type-stack"></a>

### `stack`

A stack. `icon` is vanilla's `#item_id_aux` (network id << 16 | aux): bound as
`#item_id_aux` in a collection row, an `item_renderer` draws the item.

```wit
record stack {
    key: item-key,
    icon: s64,
    count: u8,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `item-key` |  |
| `icon` | `s64` |  |
| `count` | `u8` |  |

Types: [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

<a id="type-item"></a>

### `item`

One catalog entry, retaining creative placement only when the server supplied it.

```wit
record item {
    key: item-key,
    icon: s64,
    name: string,
    group: option<string>,
    category: option<category>,
    max-stack: u8,
    tags: list<string>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `item-key` |  |
| `icon` | `s64` |  |
| `name` | `string` | The localized display name. |
| `group` | `option<string>` | The creative group's name (a language key), when the item is in a named group. |
| `category` | `option<category>` | None for an item absent from the creative content. |
| `max-stack` | `u8` |  |
| `tags` | `list<string>` | The registry's item tags. |

Types: [`category`](session-items.md#type-category), [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

### `lookup`
